record.bible_text: And thou shalt make<WH06213><WTH8804> an altar<WH04196> to burn<WH04729> incense<WH07004> upon: <FI>of<Fi> shittim<WH07848> wood<WH06086> shalt thou make<WH06213><WTH8799> it.
